::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 14th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield,  Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd),
Will Friday the 21st suit you for my coming for a conference? If you think there is any thing for me to bring let me know before Wednesday. I am going, I believe, to New College on the 31st, so that I can take anything for you.[^2]

I don’t like to give up the French spelling of the names, I don’t think Count of is a parallel, since that is translated, but I like calling people as they were christened, and it is convenient as a rule in shewing each man’s nationality without specifying it.

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: This letter is dated on the assumption that the conference referred to was over the second series of their *Historical Selections*, and that it took place during CMY's May 1869 visit to the Moberlys at Brighstone.  It appears that CMY intending subsequently to stay at New College with Sewell's brother [Edwards](people/person_1304.qmd) and sister [Janetta Sewell](people/person_1305.qmd).
